someone here is praying for their safety.

course, beside the feelings of the{1a}family or sweetheart waiting for them
at home, my own feelings are small and
weak... But if many people are waiting,
perhaps they will find that much more{1a}courage, perhaps they will treasure their
lives... That is what I think. Though it may
be presumptuous of me...
strings.tl: It is enough if they only know that someone here is praying for their safety. That they are not fighting all alone... But if many people are waiting, perhaps they will find that much more courage, perhaps they will treasure their lives... That is what I think. Though it may be presumptuous of me...

strings.en:
{1c:10}It has been 5,000 years since the Child
of God, Anoia, received the revelation of
the Two Supreme Gods, 'Zemen', god of
the sun, and 'Zeweak', god of the{1a}moon. The Anoian faith has become a
great religion, followed by nine tenths of
the world's people, but sadly, for all the
economic prosperity of the Church and{1a}the Holy See, the corruption in the
hearts of the clergy seems to worsen
year by year. It may not be my place as a
priest to say so, but even without{1a}faith, people surely have within them a
heart that loves others, thanks others,
and cares for others. Please trust your
own heart, and trust the hearts of{1a}others. For I, too, believe in
you, {10}-san.
strings.tl: It has been 5,000 years since the Child of God, Anoia, received the revelation of the Two Supreme Gods, 'Zemen', god of the sun, and 'Zeweak', god of the moon. The Anoian faith has become a great religion, followed by nine tenths of the world's people, but sadly, for all the economic prosperity of the Church and the Holy See, the corruption in the hearts of the clergy seems to worsen year by year. It may not be my place as a priest to say so, but even without faith, people surely have within them a heart that loves others, thanks others, and cares for others. Please trust your own heart, and trust the hearts of others. For I, too, believe in you, [HERO]-san.

strings.en:
{1c:10}This is magic that uses a strange staff
called the 'sacred staff', and most of it
is healing magic. The 'sacred staff' is an
ancient relic found in these{1a}underground ruins. I do not know the
details myself, but Qumran-san taught
me that it is an ancient tool that draws
off the caster's strength of will,{1a}transforms and amplifies it, and gives it
to another. It is essential magic for
adventuring in the dangerous
underground ruins, but please remember{1a}that it only lends a hand to a person's
life force and natural healing, and that it
cannot command life and death. Many
believe that only members of the{1a}Church can cast it, but that
misunderstanding seems to have arisen
outside because the Holy See has
forbidden the possession of 'sacred{1a}staves'. For what Priest Magic requires
is not whether one is of the clergy, but
how great and how pure one's
wholehearted feeling for another is.
strings.tl: This is magic that uses a strange staff called the 'sacred staff', and most of it is healing magic. The 'sacred staff' is an ancient relic found in these underground ruins. I do not know the details myself, but Qumran-san taught me that it is an ancient tool that draws off the caster's strength of will, transforms and amplifies it, and gives it to another. It is essential magic for adventuring in the dangerous underground ruins, but please remember that it only lends a hand to a person's life force and natural healing, and that it cannot command life and death. Many believe that only members of the Church can cast it, but that misunderstanding seems to have arisen outside because the Holy See has forbidden the possession of 'sacred staves'. For what Priest Magic requires is not whether one is of the clergy, but how great and how pure one's wholehearted feeling for another is.
